lines:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Migration
    participant Source
    participant Target
    participant Descriptor
    participant Clients
    User->>Migration: select destination backend
    Migration->>Source: establish consistent export and writer barrier
    Source-->>Migration: identity and complete snapshot
    Migration->>Target: stage import with schema and identity mapping
    Migration->>Target: validate references content and history
    alt validation succeeded and source unchanged
        Migration->>Descriptor: activate verified destination
        Migration->>Clients: invalidate old handles and reopen
        Migration->>Source: retain recoverable source
    else failure or interruption
        Migration->>Source: keep active source usable
        Migration-->>User: actionable recovery status
    end
